spans.s:
n. (-लं)
Wove silk: see the preceding.

Milking.
f. (-ग्धी)
A medicinal plant; also क्षीरी.
E.
दुह to milk, affix क्त.

f. (-का)
A sort of cake made of ground rice, and milk, &c. fried with ghee.

f. (-ता)
Milkiness, the nature of milk.
E.
तल् added to दुग्ध; also with त्व, दुग्धत्वं.

n. (-यं)
Milk and mangoes, mango fool.
2 The froth of milk, syllabub.
3 The skim of milk or cream.
E.
दुग्धता, लीङ् to embrace or adhere, affix छ.

n. (-नं)
A vessel for boiling milk.
E.
टुग्ध milk, and पाचन cooking.

f. (-च्छी)
A plant commonly Dugdhapeya.
E.
दुग्ध milk, and पुच्छ a tail.

n. (-नं)
The froth or skim of milk, syllabub, cream.
f. (-नी)
A small medicinal shrub, so called.
E.
दुग्ध milk, फेन froth, foam.

m. (-क्षः)
A sort of stone, (opal?)
E.
दुग्ध milk, and अक्ष a die, &c.

n. (-ब्धिः)
The sea of milk.
E.
दुग्ध, and अब्धि sea.

f. (-या)
A name of LAKṢMI.
E.
दुग्धाब्धि, and तनया daughter.

f. (-का)
A sort of Asclepias, (A. rosea, Rox.) (the Hindi derivative Dūdhi, is also applied to Euphorbia hirta and thymifolia.)
E.
दुग्ध milk, and ठन् affix, and the feminine form; the leaves, &c. yielding a milky sap.

mfn. (-ग्धी-ग्धिनी-ग्धि)
Milky, having milk.
E.
दुग्ध, and इनि aff.

f. (-का)
A plant described as a red sort of Apang, (Achyranthes aspera.)
